# Isola

> Rev-share bookkeeping for creator teams on Fortnite, Roblox, Minecraft and FiveM. Keeps a payout record every collaborator can see and nobody — including the owner — can quietly edit.

Isola is a web application at https://app.isola.gg. A working demo that needs no account runs at https://isola.gg/demo.

## The problem it solves

A creator team publishes something, the platform pays one account, and one person then splits the money by hand. Two things go wrong.

**Estimates get revised.** Platforms post a provisional figure and settle a different one weeks later. When the final number is lower, the person who already told everyone what they earned has to walk it back.

**Spreadsheets get edited.** A shared sheet has no history anyone can trust. When a figure changes, there is no way to show it was not changed quietly.

## How it works

1. A split is agreed per place, not per team, because collaborators differ on each one. Shares are in basis points and must total exactly 100%.
2. Every named contributor approves the split before a period can be locked. Nobody sets their own share.
3. The owner posts the platform's provisional figures, then the final ones.
4. Each contributor sees their own statement: a running balance, what has been paid, and a CSV export.

When a final figure differs from the estimate, the provisional credit is reversed and replaced rather than edited, and the difference carries into the next month. **Nobody is ever asked to send money back.**

## What makes it different

**It never touches the money.** The platform pays the owner, the owner pays the team through their own bank, and Isola keeps the record. There is no float, no custody, and no cut of the payout.

**The record is append-only.** Statements are frozen when posted, so a September statement reads identically in December. Every split version, approval, figure and payment is recorded with who did it and when. Nothing can be removed.

**Anyone on the team can verify the books balance**, not just the owner. The check confirms each person's stated balance equals their own entries, each period accounted for exactly what it took in, and every provisional estimate was reversed exactly once. It reports and never repairs.

**It knows which revenue streams settle in two stages.** Engagement-type payouts move between estimate and final; game passes, in-island purchases and store sales do not. So a change to a fixed stream is flagged as a probable keying error rather than accepted silently.

## Platforms

| Platform | A place is called | Revenue streams |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fortnite | Island | Engagement payout, in-island transactions, Support-a-Creator, sponsored row |
| Roblox | Experience | Engagement payout, game passes, developer products, Premium payouts, paid access |
| Minecraft | Server or map | Marketplace sales, Character Creator items, server store, subscriptions |
| FiveM | Server | Store sales, donations, subscriptions, asset sales |

A team can run places on more than one platform and keep one set of books.

## Pricing

Priced on the volume a team handles, not on how many people are added. Charging per collaborator would penalise adding the people whose visibility is the point.

| Plan | Price | Monthly volume |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free | £0 | Up to $2,000 |
| Starter | $39/mo | Up to $25,000 |
| Studio | $89/mo | Up to $100,000 |
| Pro | $199/mo | No limit |

Yearly billing is ten months charged for twelve — a 17% discount on every plan.

**Every feature is on every plan.** No feature sits behind a higher tier. What paid plans add is owner convenience at scale: scheduled statements, a year-end pack, automatic exchange rates, unlimited accountant links, read-only API access and extra Discord commands.

**Reading and exporting your own records is free on every plan and always will be.** A bookkeeping tool that locks people out of their own records over an invoice has stopped being worth trusting.

## Also included on every plan

- An account for every contributor
- Read-only books access for an accountant, with no account needed
- A full snapshot export of everything, for a year end or a dispute
- Bank reconciliation against your own statement
- Expenses and recoupable advances
- Profit and loss across places and streams
- A Discord bot for checking balances and approving splits in chat
- Six languages: English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German, Japanese

## Using it

**Adding the Discord bot.** Open your team, go to the Discord tab, and press
Link Discord. You get a code, then run `/link` with it in any server the bot
is in. The code expires in 15 minutes and works once. If the bot is not in
your server yet, an owner adds it from the link on the Discord tab — it needs
permission to read and send messages in the channels you want it in.

**Discord commands.** `/help` explains the rest and works before you have
linked anything. `/balance` shows what you are owed. `/statement` shows how it
got there. `/approve` signs off a split waiting on you. `/period` shows where
this month has got to. `/split` shows what your team agreed. `/check` confirms
the books balance and anyone can run it. `/chase` reminds whoever has not
approved, and is owner-only. `/owed`, `/pnl` and `/studio` are owner
conveniences on paid plans.

**Adding a place.** Islands tab, Add a place. Choose the platform, give it a
name, and add the code players use to find it if your platform has one.
Minecraft and FiveM have no player-facing code, so that field is optional
there.

**Why a period will not lock.** Every named contributor has to approve the
split first, and every live place needs an agreed split. The message names who
is still outstanding.

**Why a figure was refused.** Revenue streams belong to a platform. A Roblox
game pass figure posted against a Fortnite island is refused, because the two
platforms reconcile differently.

**Importing figures.** Periods tab, Import figures. Paste the payout export
from your platform. It shows what it read and what it could not, and nothing
is recorded until you choose to.

**Inviting people.** People tab. They get a link, set their own password, and
nobody else ever sees it. Everyone gets an account on every plan.

**Giving an accountant access.** People tab, Access. Creates a read-only link
that needs no account and can be revoked instantly. It never shows an
individual contributor's balance.

**Getting paid out.** Isola never moves money. It records what is owed; you
pay through your own bank and record the payment.

## Facts

- Money is stored as integer cents; splits use largest-remainder so parts always sum to the whole
- Exchange rates are fixed at the posting date and cannot be changed afterwards
- Isola is a record-keeping tool, not an accountant, and nothing in it is financial advice
- Not affiliated with Epic Games, Roblox Corporation, Mojang or Cfx.re
